We need DBE for C9H10ClNO. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens as H). For halogen, treat as H. So effective H = H + X (Cl). So H_eff = 10 + 1 =11. N =1. C=9. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 + N/2 +1 = 9 - 11/2 + 0.5 +1 = 9 -5.5 +0.5 +1 = 5.0. So DBE =5. Integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula.
